title: ervatamia microphylla
intro: Ervatamia microphylla, commonly known as the "Thai Snakeskin Vine", is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for its therapeutic properties and has been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, infections, and fever. The health benefits of Ervatamia microphylla are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and other secondary metabolites, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities. The bioactive constituents of Ervatamia microphylla include ervatamine, which has been shown to have potential therapeutic applications in the treatment of various diseases.
